title: Yearly Release Frequency Delta
scenario: Calculate the difference in number of games released by a studio between the current year and the previous year.
tableSchema: developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT), games (game_id INT, release_year INT)
hint: Count games per studio/year, then use LAG().
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name, release_year, cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER(PARTITION BY studio_name ORDER BY release_year) as delta FROM (SELECT d.studio_name, g.release_year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM developers d JOIN games g ON d.game_id = g.game_id GROUP BY d.studio_name, g.release_year) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT); CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT);
